unicode_note: Provisional: U+2059 FIVE DOT PUNCTUATION is the nearest standard character; Pugin's ornament has seventeen dots (Q35).
description: Seventeen round dots: four squares of four about a dot in the middle, all one size, on a square grid. It stands centred on half the cap height, as Pugin's does among the letters of its row.

measured.units: plate pixels, y down; tensions 0–1; angles in degrees
